profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Senior .Net Developer at Escher Group with over fourteen years of experience, I specialize in maintaining and enhancing the USPS Self Service Kiosk using .Net 4.8. My work involves designing and implementing solutions for client change requests, integrating external hardware like credit card readers and Bluetooth receipt printers, and creating Dependency Injected modules for feature expansions. I also contributed to the Thailand rollout of a web service backend using .Net 8, Postman, and SQL Server.  

With a demonstrated ability to work on systems requiring government clearance, I am dedicated to delivering robust and secure software solutions. My expertise in hardware integration and API dependencies, combined with hands-on experience with prototype hardware for mobile solutions, reflects a commitment to innovation and technical excellence in software development.

My hobbies include hobby electronics (Arduino, Raspberry Pi, etc...), messing around with personal Docker servers, and participating in game jams.

positions.title: Sr .Net Developer
positions.description:
Maintain and add features to USPS Self Service Kiosk –.Net 4.8
•	Obtained government clearance to work on USPS networks
•	Designed and implemented solutions to fit Change Requests from client
•	Worked with external hardware, including: Ingenico credit card readers and pin pads, Bluetooth receipt printers, and Microcom label printers
•	Designed & implemented Dependency Injected modules to add new features
•	Code depended on a central product and any new code was customizations applied to that product to add specialized features, such as hardware integration or API dependencies.
Worked with prototype hardware for mobile solutions -- .Net 4.8
Assisted with Thailand rollout of web service back end -- .Net 8, Postman, SQL Server 2019 2 years
•	Created service for contactless payment processing that consumed APIs from multiple banking providers
o	Implemented in .Net 8. Monitors SQL server database for changes
o	API Interfaces were implementations of an interface class 
o	Postman was used to test and build API calls to bank test servers
•	Assisted in writing new services to import and export shipping information with Universal Postal Union APIs
o	Implemented in .Net 8 & Microsoft SQL Server 2019.
o	Used SSIS in building stored queries and functions – database was interfaced with using DTOs based on stored queries and functions.
o	LINQ was used in processing results of queries.
o	Postman was used to test both UPU and service APIs
•	Assisted in full-stack implementation of .Net MAUI app for delivery drivers
o	Delivery app interfaced with web API
o	Nunit unit tests implemented 
o	Postman used to help design and test API
Trained on Copilot CLI .Net 4.8, .Net 8
•	Implemented new modules on core product quickly
•	Fixed theming engine in core product to support dark mode
•	Interfaced with custom MCPs via Copilot CLI config file
